text:
mira: Quick question — for the least-privilege keys rollout, do we need to show full attribute parity in the Console (org/project/service-account) or can telemetry + API-only work for the first canary?

alex: I'd prefer parity in the console from day 1 for discoverability. PMs will get mad if users can't see what claims are attached.

mira: Understandable. The concern is rollout velocity — UI work is nontrivial and blocks canary-wide testing.

cheng: Can we do a hybrid? Show basic attributes (owner, scope, issued_at, expiry) in console, hide advanced claim mappings and raw JWT unless "advanced view" toggle enabled. That reduces UI effort but keeps parity for common cases.

lia: +1 for hybrid. Also we need to ensure query performance — pulling claim sets for thousands of keys on the org page might blow up list rendering. We should lazy load per-row or fetch on expand.

sam: Telemetry note: if we rely on API-only for advanced fields during canary, we need to emit sample events: key.view.basic, key.view.advanced via console and key.api.fetch. Tag with canary=true. We need that to validate user flows.

katie: UX risk — if console shows basic attrs but not rate_quota/billing_affinity, support tickets spike. Can we at least show quota tier and project affiliation? Those are the top two questions SRE gets.

mira: Good call. So minimal console surface: owner, scope (org/project/sa), expiry, quota_tier, project_affinity. Advanced: claim_mappings, raw_jwt, impersonation_chain. Advanced behind toggle.

cheng: Backend implications: the existing key index has owner_id and project_id but not denormalized quota_tier or impersonation_chain. We can add a lightweight index column quota_tier (string) and a compact impersonation_summary (string) for listing. Adding columns is cheap.

alex: Routing/ quota interplay: when project_affinity exists we should route requests to project-specific quota buckets first. Edge case: service accounts minted under org but bound to project — need deterministic precedence. Proposal: explicit project_affinity overrides org default, else fallback to org.

lia: Agree. Also add a small UI hint if affinity is overridden: "Affinity: project X (overrides org default)". Helps SRE and billing.

sam: For telemetry, please include fields: key_id, actor_type (user/sa), affinity, canary_flag. Example event: {"event":"key.api.fetch","key_id":"k_123","affinity":"project:foo","canary":"true"} — we'll log as JSON blob.

katie: We're going to need a support playbook entry: how to interpret "affinity mismatch" alerts. Can we surface the canonical routing decision in the Console (like a small badge) so support can triage without asking infra?

mira: Yes. Plan for canary: API & telemetry only for advanced fields + UI showing minimal surface. Canary window 2 weeks, sample 10% orgs, feature flag gated. If telemetry stable and <1% support uplift, ship full console parity.

deploy-bot: deploy started: feature-flag=leastpriv-rollout-canary, shard=eu-west-1, rollout_pct=10% (2024-11-12T09:08:30Z)

cheng: Implementation notes — avoid N+1 reads on org page: prefetch quota_tier and affinity in single join. Use paginated endpoint with include=list_attributes=true. UI should request list attributes only when user opens org list.

lia: Also add a circuit-breaker: if list query latency > 300ms, UI falls back to basic minimal view and logs telemetry key.view.degraded with stack id.

mira: Sounds good. I'll document rollout plan and attach to the canary ticket. Thanks all — I'll follow up with PM and support to draft the KB blurb.

alex: One more: encryption/secret scanning — we must not show raw_jwt in Console unless customer opts in and workspace has secret-display permission. Add audit log entry when raw_jwt viewed.

sam: Noted. Telemetry for that: key.raw_jwt.view with redaction_status.

katie: OK, support playbook stub: triage steps, how to read affinity badge, escalate to eng-platform if audit entries show raw_jwt.view.

mira: Closing loop — I'll push the PR for quota_tier denorm and the API flag later today. Thanks everyone.

cheng: Will review PR.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: feature-flag=leastpriv-rollout-canary, shard=eu-west-1, rollout_pct=10% (2024-11-12T09:12:03Z)

lia: Watching telemetry dashboards. Will post if we see any anomalies.

mira: End of thread.
